summary: Frontend-only regression + feature testing for new Interface and Elements pages (Laravel 12 admin panel). 82/83 scripted assertions passed. The single 'fail' was a false-positive in my test selector (checking substring 'bg-muted' against nav-dashboard class which contains 'hover:bg-muted') — verified visually that active-state indicator (accent bar + bg-muted) works correctly only on the active nav item. All 20 interface panels and all 20 element panels render. All interactions tested (tabs, accordion, dropdown outside-click, star rating, alert dismiss, modals with Escape, toasts, password strength 'kuat', pw-toggle, textarea char-count, range, stepper, OTP autofocus, copy toast, seed tags [produksi, billing, v2], tag add/remove, form submit with no navigation). Auth guard confirmed (302 on /interface and /elements when logged out). Panel titles decode HTML entities correctly ('Badges & Tags'). Compact UI verified: input h=28, panel header h=32, body font-family='Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif'. No horizontal scroll at 1920 or 1280 widths. Dark theme toggles correctly. Regression: dashboard nav + logout still work. Laravel log is clean (0 errors).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: apCopy() calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without try/catch — in sandboxed/insecure contexts it throws an unhandled promise rejection (observed as PAGEERROR in test). Wrap in try/catch or use .catch() to keep console clean.

Minor: elements.blade.php uses id='cards' for the Choice cards panel while interface.blade.php also has id='cards' for the Cards panel — fine since separate pages, but distinct IDs would be safer if the pages ever merge or share anchors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interface at /interface and Elements at /elements both fully functional. All 40 panels render, all interactions verified, no Blade/PHP errors, no horizontal scroll at 1920 or 1280. The expected Tailwind CDN production warning is the only console noise. If retesting the nav active-state, use exact-match check (e.g. exact class or presence of accent bar span), not substring match on 'bg-muted' — because inactive nav items contain 'hover:bg-muted'.
